kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننهزم (form VII)
# نَنْهَزِمُ (nanhazimu) /nan.ha.zi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْهَزَمَ (inhazama)
# نَنْهَزِمَ (nanhazima) /nan.ha.zi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَزَمَ (inhazama)
# نَنْهَزِمْ (nanhazim) /nan.ha.zim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْهَزَمَ (inhazama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
